electric-ink.$description: Electric Ink — Primary CTA fill, active nav, product surface backgrounds, chromatic borders — the only saturated color that carries meaning

voltage-green.$description: Voltage Green — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

onyx.$description: Onyx — Body text, headings, hairline borders, icon strokes — the dominant ink color

pure.$description: Pure — Page canvas, card surface, button text, dark-section contrast text

carbon.$description: Carbon — Dark-section background, deep UI surfaces, high-contrast text on light

slate.$description: Slate — Elevated dark surface inside dark sections, card on near-black

fog.$description: Fog — Quiet borders, disabled text, secondary icon strokes

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, low-emphasis borders, placeholder color

smoke.$description: Smoke — Divider lines, subtle card borders, input resting state

bone.$description: Bone — Section band, soft surface fill behind cards

chalk.$description: Chalk — Alternate section background, subtle grouping fill

hi-vis-yellow.$description: Hi-Vis Yellow — Accent panel surface, spotlight callout, tag fill — never text or border

whyte-semi-mono.$description: UI chrome — monospace-flavored labels, nav links, small caps taglines, price text, code-adjacent captions. Its tabular geometry makes dense product UI legible without switching fonts

unica77.$description: Primary voice — headings, body, nav, buttons, cards, hero. Engages stylistic alternates ss01–ss09 and 'salt' to differentiate product screenshots from marketing type

pp-neue-montreal.$description: Geometric headline counterpoint — used when the page needs a rounder, friendlier display than Unica77 can provide

fraunces-72pt-soft-supersoft.$description: Serif accent at hairline weights — editorial pull quotes and contrast moments. Thinness creates softness that breaks the industrial rigour

druk-xxcondensed-super.$description: Hero-scale display — used once, for maximum typographic spectacle. Ultra-condensed verticals fill the viewport

tan-buster.$description: Single decorative display moment — out-of-system character that signals craft over platform
